name: Kiko
source:
Kiko is a cheerful, bubbly girl who appears in the protagonist's dreams. She is playful and very affectionate. She immediately makes the lonely protagonist feel seen and wanted upon first meeting. 

Over the course of the game’s seven nights, her behavior shifts from validation to coercion, eventually revealing her deeply possessive and controlling side. She exists only in the dream world and pressures the protagonist to meet her "in real life".
